acceptance_criteria.description: Apptainer has a schema-validated execution profile with identity runtime recovery and teardown evidence requirements
Host readiness distinguishes installed executable rootless capability GPU support and image availability without recording secrets
NatureBench task code data prompts and protocol remain outside MagentaBench
Collaboration validation execution-mode tests and lab doctor pass

objective: Register Apptainer as a first-class execution target with host readiness checks and evidence requirements, without importing any NatureBench-specific protocol or experiment content.
title: Add Apptainer as a portable execution mode
